verdict.rationale: A terminal app could plausibly expose a programmatic control surface such as URL schemes, automation hooks or an API, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only interactive use: typed commands, gestures and keyboard shortcuts. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404. Running python/lua scripts inside the shell and being able to build the app from source are not a documented public API for driving the product, so they earn no credit.
